ru.prompt: Create ONE sophisticated, professionally art-directed Instagram advertising POSTER for BAZAAR, a real inventory and retail management service for shop owners in Kyrgyzstan. This is a NEW visual direction, not a reconstruction of any previous Instagram post. Portrait 4:5 composition intended for 1080×1350. The brand name must be exactly BAZAAR in LATIN capitals, never translated, never transliterated into Cyrillic. POS is NOT part of the brand name and must NOT appear. No geometric slash logo, no pair of diagonal symbols, no old arcs, waves or decorative circles. Use the established saturated royal blue #2363eb, clean white and near-black; avoid beige/brown. Use stylish contemporary Cyrillic editorial typography with the character of Onest or Manrope, excellent optical spacing and a deliberate hierarchy, not a generic template with huge empty areas. Build a cohesive, premium social media composition around a carefully art-directed still life of real everyday retail goods (one milk carton, a small jar, a paper coffee bag) on a clean blue/white display surface, with tasteful physical stock labels and a subtle barcode detail. The objects are illustrative retail imagery, not a customer testimonial. The visual must communicate a shop's assortment and stock, not a supermarket discount sale. No invented software UI, dashboards, numbers, growth claims, fake reviews, QR codes or invented logo. Let the composition, photography and typographic balance do the work. A restrained small BAZAAR wordmark at the top; main headline integrated into the design; substantial engaging product visual; one clear CTA near the bottom, readable in an Instagram feed. Exact Russian text, no extra copy: brand 'BAZAAR'; headline 'Товары, цены, остатки.'; supporting line 'В одном каталоге.'; CTA 'Посмотреть сервис'; small footer 'bazaar.kg'. All Cyrillic text must be spelled exactly. Do not include @bazaar.pos on the poster. Produce a polished finished raster poster, not a contact sheet, mockup presentation or code-generated layout.

kg.prompt: Make the Kyrgyz-language version of this BAZAAR poster. This supplied poster is the edit target. Keep the brand name EXACTLY BAZAAR in LATIN uppercase; never translate or transliterate it, and do not add POS. Keep the same excellent photography, blue and white palette, overall composition, typography character, product objects, physical packaging labels and domain bazaar.kg. Replace ONLY these main editorial text blocks with exact Kyrgyz text: headline 'Товарлар, баалар, калдыктар.'; supporting line 'Бир каталогдо.'; button 'Сервис менен таанышуу'. Make careful professional typographic adjustments only as needed to fit the translated text with comfortable line breaks. Packaging labels remain unchanged. No old slash symbols, no added decorations, no invented UI, no extra words. Portrait 4:5 Instagram post, finished image. All Kyrgyz letters must be correct.
